style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 1.5m Pre Lit LED Outdoor Christmas Fir Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Add a magical, festive touch to your front door this winter with this 1.5m pre-lit outdoor garland.<br><br>Carefully crafted from mixed green faux foliage and dotted with 30 warm white LEDs, our garland is created from anti-rust materials, making it a perfect choice for framing a front door or porch. Alternatively, drape the garland across a mantlepiece or bookshelf if you’d prefer to bring the season inside.<br><br>All wreaths and garlands will require styling on arrival, lay flat and tease the foliage for a styled and finished look. Shaping your foliage may result in some variance from the listed dimensions.<br><br>To illuminate, simply add 3 x AA batteries to the attached battery box. Set the handy 6 hour timer for an automatic glow at the same time each evening. Size : ONE
